name: Supabase MCP server
summary: Supabase's hosted MCP server at mcp.supabase.com/mcp gives an agent holding an OAuth grant for a Supabase organization, or a scoped personal access token, tools over projects, databases, logs, Edge Functions, branches and storage, in eight documented feature groups. Keyless on 2026-10-19 every form of the path answered 401 with a 38-byte body and an RFC 9728 challenge. The protected-resource document names api.supabase.com as the authorization server and thirteen scopes; the resource host itself publishes no authorization-server document.

agentAccess.notes: Keyless 2026-10-19: initialize to mcp.supabase.com/mcp, a GET of it, ?read_only=true and ?features=docs each answered 401 'No access token provided' with a resource_metadata challenge. The vendor documents dynamic client registration, a scoped personal access token for CI, or a manual OAuth app.

payments.notes: 2026-10-19: no keyless 402. Four plans, Free at $0/month; the MCP server has no price of its own and its branching tools say 'Requires a paid plan.' Terms: the customer authorizes Supabase to charge the payment method in the account; AWS Marketplace purchases contract with Supabase, Inc.

jobs.summary: The vendor's tool list has a Docs group with one tool, search_docs, described as 'Search Supabase documentation'. Documentation only: the group is behind the same OAuth gate as the rest (initialize with ?features=docs answered 401 keyless on 2026-10-19), so nothing was retrieved.
